technique_name: Write a blog post discussing new trends in data science
description: Data science is an ever-evolving field and the new trends will shape the way businesses use data to drive decisions and create value. One of the most noteworthy trends is the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning. By taking advantage of huge datasets, these technologies are helping organizations mine data and extract insights in ways that weren’t possible before.
